self_report: Understands a lot of Russian and knows many words passively, learned mostly by ear. Has rarely written Russian and spells words the way he pronounces them. Struggles with grammar (endings, cases) and with expressing himself in speaking and writing.
goals: Speak and write Russian accurately and with confidence
Control case endings and verb aspect in real sentences
Close the gap between what he understands and what he can say

overall.note: Placement in progress: grammar test (2026-11-08), writing sample (2026-11-09) and speaking sample (2026-11-18) done. Reading report still to come.

writing.evidence: Writing sample 2026-11-09 (w-a2-01, 79 words): a connected story with connectors (но, поэтому), feelings and a sequence of events; some B1 vocabulary (дешевле, пригласил, проверить). 45 errors = 57 per 100 words: 22 spelling, 20 grammar (25 per 100 words: accusative objects and time phrases, dative, agreement, numbers), 3 word choice. Meaning clear throughout except one phrase. A2 task fulfilment with A2-bottom accuracy; one sample only.

speaking.evidence: Speaking sample 2026-11-18 (voice mode, about 10 min, 15 turns, 189 words, interviewer-led): answered every question on studies, work, weekend plans and food; gave reasons (потому что) and a concession (конечно…, но…); asked for clarification in Russian. Turns average 13 words, longest 28 (2–3 clauses joined with и, но, потому что). Did not narrate the past weekend (avoided it). 18 grammar errors = 9.5 per 100 words (motion verbs идти/ехать 3, future 3, accusative 2, instrumental 2, pronouns 2, verb endings 2) + 4 word-choice errors (3 German calques); meaning always clear. A2 interaction with A2 accuracy; one sample only. Transcript only: pronunciation not judged, and speech recognition may hide or add ending errors, so the error rate is probably an underestimate.

grammar.evidence: Placement 2026-11-08, raw: A1 6/11 (55%), A2 4/11 (36%), B1 2/11 (18%), B2 1/11. Counting 5 spelling-only errors as grammar-correct: A1 8/11 (73%), A2 4/11, B1 5/11 (45%). Below the 75% bar even at A1, so no level recorded yet. Patchy profile: some B1 structures known (чтобы + past, prefixed motion verbs, -ами), basic singular endings and agreement not yet reliable. Writing sample 2026-11-09: masculine past (болел, купил, пригласил) and perfective after надо (прочитать, проверить) right; endings on objects mostly missing (мой школьная работа, пригласил они), plural agreement wrong (они был). Speaking 2026-11-18: right in speech: мне нравится + nominative, надо + infinitive, заниматься спортом, с + instrumental, будем + imperfective, нет … планов; wrong: идти for trips by car (3), буду + perfective (4, once right after a correction), *этом for в эти выходные, *занимаюсь с + noun.

vocabulary.evidence: Active everyday vocabulary is solid in translations and the writing sample (пригласил, дешевле, сразу, проверить, костюмы, ресторан); some word-choice slips (тоже for 'also', обед for an evening meal). Not measured in reading yet. Speaking 2026-11-18: enough range for studies, work, weekend plans and food; three gaps filled with German calques (e.g. праксис for практика, делать кушать for готовить); register slips (девчонка, кушать about himself).

weak_points.label: Writes by ear: unstressed о→а, е→и, ё→о, missing ь (-шь, фильм), ы/и, не + verb joined
Accusative for objects and time phrases (кого? что? когда?)
Dative: кому? (писать, звонить, помогать) and after благодаря
Genitive after нет / много, and for people in the plural
Agreement with the subject: past tense gender, мне понравился / понравилась
Numbers with nouns: 2–4 + genitive singular; евро never changes
Instrumental after с and after заниматься (no с!); prepositional of -ия nouns and city names
Aspect: process vs one result (past), когда + perfective future
examples: *я отдавал работу (handed in, done) → я сдал работу

weak_points.label: тоже (too, same as someone) vs ещё / также (also, in addition)
examples: *Но я тоже уже работаю → А ещё я уже работаю

weak_points.label: Future: буду + imperfective only (буду делать); perfective verbs have a one-word future (сделаю, прочитаю, поедем)
examples: *я буду прочитать → я буду читать / я прочитаю

weak_points.label: идти / ходить (on foot) vs ехать / ездить (by car or train, to another city or country); ходить / ездить for habits
examples: *мы пойдём на машине → мы поедем на машине
*часто я пойду гулять → часто я хожу гулять

weak_points.label: Pronouns: он / она follows the noun's gender (фирма → у неё); after нет use ни-: нет никаких планов
German calques and register: Praxis → практика, Essen machen → готовить; девчонка (slang) → девушка, кушать about yourself → есть

strengths: Understands a lot and has a useful active vocabulary for everyday topics
Tells a connected story with connectors (но, поэтому), feelings and reasons
Already uses key patterns: мне нравится, у неё (есть), с + instrumental, чтобы + past
Masculine past tense and common perfective verbs mostly right (купил, пригласил, проверить)
Keeps a conversation going: in a 10-minute voice conversation he answered every question, gave reasons (потому что, конечно…, но…) and asked for clarification in Russian

plan.next_session: Finish placement: paste the app report for the A2 reading 'Выходные без телефона' (Home → Report for Claude → Copy report), then set first levels. Lessons after that: 1) spelling sheet and test (milestone 22 Nov), 2) accusative for objects, time and direction (в эти выходные, в город), 3) talking about plans: буду делать vs сделаю, пойду vs поеду, 4) dative (кому?).

milestones.goal: Retake the placement test: A1 items at 85%+ and A2 items at 75%+

history.summary: Russian Coach set up: app, starter deck, grammar sheets, tests and readings. No assessment yet.

Placement part 1 (grammar test): 13/44 objective (30%); A1 6/11, A2 4/11, B1 2/11, B2 1/11. Five errors were spelling-only, so the adjusted scores are A1 73%, B1 45%. Translations: meaning clear in 3 of 4, about 60 errors per 100 words, half of them spelling.

Placement part 2 (writing sample, A2 prompt, 79 words): connected story with A2 task fulfilment; 57 errors per 100 words (22 spelling, 20 grammar, 3 word choice). Initial writing level A2, low confidence. +15 cards.

Placement part 3 (speaking sample, voice mode, about 10 min, 15 turns, 189 words): answered every question, gave reasons and plans, asked for clarification in Russian; turns average 13 words. 18 grammar errors (9.5 per 100 words: motion verbs, буду + perfective, accusative, instrumental) and 4 word-choice errors; meaning always clear. Initial speaking level A2, low confidence. +16 cards.

evidence.after_sample: буду + perfective twice more (once right after a correction), then right: я буду читать; сколько + nominative once
evidence.limits: Transcript only: pronunciation not judged; speech recognition may hide or add ending errors; the first two turns were misrecognised as German and excluded.
